description: Schedule a post to ONE connected account at a given time, or publish it immediately with scheduled_at="now". This queues real content for a real audience — show the user the exact text, account and time and get explicit approval first. To post the same content to several accounts, call once per account with the same post_batch_id. The user's post signature is appended server-side, and the safety gateway may refuse a post (account health, daily limits, duplicates).

first_comment.description: Optional first comment posted under the post (max 2200 characters).

media_urls.description: Up to 10 publicly reachable media URLs to attach.

platform.description: Platform of that connected account (must match it).

platform_meta.description: Platform-specific publish settings, passed through to the publisher. Examples: Reddit { subreddit, flairId }, Pinterest { board }, Discord/Slack { channelId }, YouTube { title, privacyStatus }, Hashnode/Medium { publicationId }, Listmonk { listId, templateId }, Lemmy { communityId }, Skool { groupId }. Look up valid ids with list_publish_options.

post_batch_id.description: UUID shared by every call that posts the same content to different accounts, so they can later be managed together.

scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime with timezone (e.g. 2030-01-01T09:00:00Z), or "now" to publish immediately.

tag_ids.description: Up to 20 post tag UUIDs to apply.

variant_id.description: UUID of the draft (from list_drafts or generate_posts) this post was made from; marks that draft as scheduled.

name: schedule_post
